content:
Last week Sonos announced a number of upcoming app features, and the first batch of upgrades has officially arrived with the "Sonos 27" app update. Here's the full rundown.

Below are the new features and upcoming additions in what Sonos is calling Sonos 27.

Following the lead of iOS 27 and the like, Sonos has adopted a new naming convention for its software platform: "Sonos 27."

Today, Sonos 27 officially launched via a new app update on the App Store. Wondering whether your hardware is compatible? Sonos says it works with "all Sonos S2 products," though features will vary by device.

Here are the features Sonos says are available right now:

  • Portable Surround Sound: "Two identical Sonos portable speakers (Move 2 or Sonos Play) can be paired as surround sound rear speakers compatible with a soundbar. When the speakers are moved, they revert to their original role, allowing existing hardware to do more without requiring an additional home theater setup."
  • All-New Sonos 27 App Navigation: "A redesigned app with cleaner navigation, swipe gestures, and the ability to pin rooms for faster control."
  • Headphone Connectivity (Early Access): "Connect Ace Ultra headphones to your Sonos system, allowing users to push or pull audio between nearby speakers and headphones without using a phone as a middleman."
  • Sonos 27 MCP (Early Access): "Connect AI assistants including ChatGPT and Claude to Sonos, giving you more choices rather than being locked into a single assistant."

Sonos also highlighted two features coming later:

  • Sonos 27 Voice (Coming later this fall): "Sonos' own music-focused assistant, emphasizing that no single AI should control the home and putting consumer choice at its core."
  • Sonos Custom Agents (2027): "Allow users to create their own agents within the system, each with its own dedicated model, personality, and voice."

Sonos caused quite a stir a few years ago when it rolled out a major app redesign. This navigation update looks far smaller in scope, so hopefully it won't stir up another controversy.

What do you think of the Sonos 27 app changes? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
